name: Member
definition: An individual on the Student Club roster, identified by member_id. The roster contains regular members, club officers and inactive persons.
scope: Questions about who belongs to the club, a person's identity or affiliation.

name: Member Full Name
definition: The complete personal name of a member, formed from the member's first name and last name.
scope: Questions that name a person (e.g. 'Maya Mclean') or ask for a 'full name' / 'name of member'.

name: Member Position
definition: The role a member holds in the club, distinguishing regular members from officers and inactive persons.
scope: Filtering or grouping the roster by role.

name: T-Shirt Size
definition: The t-shirt size recorded for a member.
scope: Roster attribute used to segment members.

name: Major
definition: An academic major (degree program) a member is enrolled in, identified by major_id and named by major_name. Each major is offered by exactly one department and one college.
scope: Academic affiliation of a member.

name: Academic Department
definition: An academic department, program or school that offers one or more majors. Each department belongs to exactly one college.
scope: Intermediate academic unit between major and college.

name: College
definition: The highest-level academic unit in the major hierarchy; a college is composed of departments.
scope: Top-level academic affiliation.

name: Event
definition: An activity organized by the Student Club, identified by event_id and named by event_name.
scope: Any question about club activities, their schedule, type, status or location.

name: Event Date
definition: The scheduled date and time of an event, stored as an ISO-8601 date-time string.
scope: Time filtering and ordering of events.

name: Event Year
definition: The calendar year in which an event took place, taken from the year portion of the event date.
scope: Yearly grouping or year-over-year comparison of events and spending.

name: Event Type
definition: The kind of activity an event represents (e.g. Meeting, Guest Speaker, Game, Social, Election, Community Service, Registration, Budget).
scope: Classifying events by the nature of the activity.

name: Event Status
definition: The lifecycle status of an event: Open, Closed or Planning.
scope: Filtering events by whether they are still open, closed or still being planned.

name: Event Location
definition: The place where an event is held, recorded as free text (e.g. 'MU 215').
scope: Locating events by venue.

name: Budget Line
definition: A budget allocation for one spending category of one event, identified by budget_id.
scope: Per-category budgeting for an event.

name: Amount Budgeted
definition: The planned/allocated amount of money for a spending category of an event (the budgeted amount).
scope: Questions about how much was budgeted or allocated, e.g. for an event or category.

name: Amount Spent
definition: The amount of money actually spent against a budget line of an event.
scope: Questions about money spent, total spent, or spending by category/event.

name: Budget Category
definition: The spending category a budget line covers: Advertisement, Club T-Shirts, Food, Parking or Speaker Gifts.
scope: Budgeting and spending questions grouped by category.

name: Budget Event Status
definition: The status of the event as recorded on the budget line; it mirrors the event's own status.
scope: Status filtering performed on budget rows rather than on the event table.

name: Expense
definition: A single expenditure made by a member and charged to a budget line, identified by expense_id.
scope: Individual purchases or payments behind the club's spending.

name: Expense Cost
definition: The monetary cost of a single expense record.
scope: Total or per-item cost of expenses.

name: Expense Description
definition: Free-text description of what an expense was for.
scope: Identifying an expense by what was bought or paid for.

name: Expense Date
definition: The date on which an expense was incurred, stored as an ISO date string.
scope: Time filtering of expenses.

name: Income
definition: A receipt of funds by the Student Club from a stated source, identified by income_id and optionally linked to the member it came from.
scope: Money coming into the club: dues, fundraising, sponsorship, appropriation.

name: Income Amount
definition: The monetary amount received in a single income record.
scope: Totals and comparisons of money received.

name: Income Source
definition: The origin of an income record, such as Dues, Fundraising, School Appropriation or Sponsorship.
scope: Classifying money received by where it came from.

name: Income Date Received
definition: The date on which funds were received, stored as an ISO date string.
scope: Time filtering of income records.

name: Event Attendance
definition: A record that a specific member attended a specific event.
scope: Questions about whether a member attended an event, or who attended which event.
